reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
The customer service is atrocious. First off, having been in this industry for a while, two main things stuck out to me as RED FLAGS:

 1) As a new player, I was trying to deposit and take advantage of the new player bonus. They ignored the majority of my messages, only for me to find out that they had changed the bonus by the time they finally responded.

 2) This is probably my main concern and the biggest red flag: they continue to send automated survey emails asking how they did. Let me tell you, when they state in an email that they cannot discuss the problem with my account and declare the case closed—still leaving me confused about what’s going on with my account—and then I instantly receive a survey right afterward? It's infuriating. 

Basically, it’s like talking to a brick wall with a brain of an elementary student behind it controlling the narrative.

By the way to note, this is my first review ever. There are plenty of other sportsbooks where you would be much better off. 

0 Stars if possible.

reviews.title: Great app when it works
reviews.text: When I initially downloaded this app and signed up with Onyx, it was great. The sign up bonus was excellent and the layout of the app is clean and well done. The payouts are what you’d expect so that’s not an issue. I had to close my account recently because for the last almost 3 weeks, 5+ sports disappeared from the app and I was no longer able to make player picks on those sports specifically the WNBA which was what I mainly used. The support was quick to respond and gave me several rewards due to the ongoing issue but they also dragged their feet and wouldn’t give me an explanation as to why this issue was occurring. After waiting several days for a supposed update, it never happened so I closed my account.

reviews.title: They try to take your money
reviews.text:
This app sucks.
A friend told me about it, so I downloaded it for the sign-up bonus. I deposited $10, got the bonus,
placed a bet with one of the free $25 and won $250. When I tried to withdraw my winnings, it took forever for approval. So while waiting on the approval  I played again with the 10 I initially uploaded, won another bet for 350. I couldn’t redeem this because I was waiting on the other approval still so while waiting I placed a 3rd on summer league. Won 133 .. the app showed that the 133 was redeemable but somehow I am still not able to withdraw the $350 money from the second win
Now I'm stuck trying to figure out why I can't access the $350 that's still sitting in my account. The whole experience has been confusing, inconsistent, and frustrating. Customer support hasn't been helpful, and I wouldn't recommend this app to anyone.
